title: The ideal-power torsion functor
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $J$ an ideal. Define the additive endofunctor $\Gamma_J$ on $R$-modules by $\Gamma_J(M)=\{x\in M\mid \exists n\in\mathbf N,\ J^n x=0\}$, where $J^n x=0$ means $a x=0$ for every $a\in J^n$. On an $R$-linear map $f:M\to N$, it sends $x$ to $f(x)$ with the induced torsion membership proof. Its right derived functors are computed by applying this functor to an injective resolution and taking cohomology.

proof.text: Use Ideal.primaryComponent for the object and Ideal.primaryComponent.map for morphisms. The identity and composition laws follow by subtype extensionality. Addition is preserved because both maps send x to f(x)+g(x).
